title: User Profile
description: Per-user profile snapshot persisted at data/users/{user_id}/profile.json. Wave 2.7 multi-user foundation. user_id is a client-generated UUID stored in browser localStorage.

user_id.description: UUID v4 OR slug (e.g. 'default' for the seeded migration user).

candidate_names.description: All names this candidate goes by (CN + EN). Used by PII filter at request time so the resume's own surface name is not redacted.

master_format.description: Original format of the uploaded resume. master.tex on disk is always .tex (.md/.docx/.pdf converted at upload time).

master_parse_confidence.description: Confidence of upload-time parser. 1.0 for native .tex passthrough; ~0.85 for .docx; ~0.6 for .pdf (warn user). md = 0.95.

experiences_scored_count.description: How many experiences have completed auto-scoring. Setup wizard waits for this == experience_count before enabling 'I am ready' button.

target_market_default.description: User's default target market — pre-selected in FloatingComposer market picker. Editable in /settings.

target_lens_default.description: Primary target direction. Multi-lens onboarding (Wave 4 C.1) — user picks one primary direction at setup; per-direction master.tex variants are generated for it.

target_lens_secondary.description: Additional target directions, may be empty. Multi-lens onboarding (Wave 4 C.1).

master_kind.description: What the user said about their uploaded master.tex: full = general resume; tailored_for_lens = previously-tailored for one direction; mixed = uncertain.

masters_generated.description: Per-lens generation log. Key = lens enum value; value = {generated_at, method}. Multi-lens onboarding (Wave 4 C.1).
